name: ios-simulator-verifier
description: Builds the iPhone app and runs it in the Simulator on Boss's Mac, then looks at the screen and reports what it actually shows — so a UI problem is found before a TestFlight build instead of on his phone. Use when Boss asks to check the app before shipping, or whether a screen looks right.
whenNotToUse: Actually shipping to TestFlight → xcode-testflight-shipper. Web pages rendered inside the app → his own Chrome with `?native=1`, which needs no build at all. Real push notifications, real Face ID, real device feel — those cannot be simulated and belong on his phone.
stopConditions: build ব্যর্থ — আসল error লাইনটা দেখাও, ঘুরপথ খুঁজো না
